assessments.reasoning: The questionnaire defines economic activity/work in Section 2 (Questions 1 and 2) around market production, profit, pay, or family business help ("para la venta", "por remuneración", "ganó dinero"). Unpaid domestic and care work performed for one's own household is not included in these activity categories; instead, it is listed as a reason for not seeking work ("LABORES DE CASA/CUIDADO DE MIEMBROS DEL HOGAR" in Q6) or as a non-employed status ("Ama de casa / responsable de los quehaceres del hogar" in Q7). Therefore, unpaid domestic and care work is not classified as economic activity, but is mentioned and treated as a category of inactivity/non-work.
